terra.problem: The moving-day comparison makes the ark itself the subject of a joke.
The passage does not say Solomon was right there when the Levites took up the ark.
The text does not say whether Solomon was present at that moment or whether anyone fought over carrying the ark.
The packing-list joke makes the contents of the ark the subject of a joke.
The closet joke makes the ark itself the subject of a joke.
The passage does not say that Goliath's sword would not have fit in the ark.
They praised with one voice, but the text does not say they sang or played the same note.
The referee joke suggests a dispute that does not fit the action of praising together.
Praising together does not establish that nobody waited for a cue.
The text does not say the praise had ended before the cloud filled the temple.
